		ManagedMember: &ManagedMemberBinding{Scope: MemberScope{ClusterID: "aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa", TenantID: "01HW000000E008000000000001", DatabaseID: "01HW000000E008000000000001", ShardID: 1, MemberID: "01HW000000E008000000000001", Incarnation: "bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb"}, HostAttempt: 1},
	}

No source/repository/ledger mutation, children, project helper/scanner or Go/test/build/runtime/cloud/crypto execution. Read-only Git/file inspection and metadata hashing/serialization only.
Regular files and temporary directories qualify only the asserted host filesystem checks; no actual block device, mount, mkfs, crash or TerraBase process is exercised.
Permit fixture uses upstream loopback TCP NATS and file-backed JetStream; host mutation reads and OCI/managed authority checks remain fixture stubs. Independent local-only blocks remain mixed.
All original safety obligations retained; no deletion, retirement, completion, runtime or count promotion authorized.
